limitations: Complete SAT enumeration for N <= 10 only.
novelty_basis: Probably a consequence of known Laver-table theory (row N is the identity and p*N = N exactly for powers of 2); not checked against the literature.
statement: For 2 <= N <= 10, an anchored magma satisfies x*(y+1) = (x*y)*(x+1) for all x, y mod N exactly when N is 2, 4 or 8 and the magma is the Laver table; so for these N, left-distributivity of an anchored table is decided by an O(N^2) check.
title: The anchor instance of left-distributivity singles out the Laver tables (N <= 10)
